sources.name: Animal Doctors International - Cambodia country page
sources.note: Opened; own organisation page. ADI Hospital Phnom Penh, phone 023 238 239, open seven days 9am-7pm (public holidays 9am-12pm), "Emergency care is available 24/7". No street address (map link only).

sources.name: Animal Doctors International - home page
sources.note: Opened; own site. Cambodia hospital hotline 023 238 239, 9am-7pm every day, lists "24/7 emergency and critical care". Confirms the country page.

sources.name: Animal Mama - Contact
sources.note: Opened; own site. Phone +85510500888, 9am-7pm daily (may close early, call first), after-7pm emergency line same number (English only) with extra after-hours fee. Not described as 24 h. No street address on the own site (home and about pages have no address/phone).

sources.name: Easy Cambodia - Animal Mama Veterinary Hospital
sources.note: Opened; directory listing, used only for the address (#15, Street 500, Phsar Daeum Thkov, Phnom Penh). Its phone (010 666 742) and "Emergency 24/7" and hours (08:00-18:00) conflict with the clinic own page, so they are not used.

sources.name: The Well Frog - Vet clinics in Phnom Penh
sources.note: Opened; aggregator, never used as a sole source. Lists Sunny Animal Hospital (32B St 368 BKK3, +855 10 461 212), Animal-Mama (House #15, Street 500, Chamkar Mon), VSL (#33 St 334 BKK1, 023 986 640), Japan Animal Hospital (M43 St 63). Its 24/7 labels are not accepted.

sources.name: IPATA member page - VSL Veterinary Clinic Cambodia
sources.note: Opened; trade-association member page. Phnom Penh, office +855 02 398-6640 and +855 01 746-4681, after-hours +855 088 818-0022, website vslveterinary.com. No address, hours or 24 h statement. vslveterinary.com itself could not be opened (WebFetch refused).

sources.name: Move to Cambodia - Veterinary care in Cambodia
sources.note: Opened; expat guide (secondary source). PPAWS (Beoung Tumpun, 017 293 654 / 078 611 289, ppaws.com, Tue-Fri and Sun), Agrovet (33B Street 360 BKK1, 023 216 323), Siem Reap Veterinary Services (Wat Damnak Village, 071 998 4413, weekdays 9-4 by appointment), Happy Pets Veterinary Clinic (Emario Beach Resort, Victory Hill, Sihanoukville, 098 215 104). Undated.

sources.name: Move to Cambodia - Sihanoukville veterinarians
sources.note: Opened; expat guide (secondary). Happy Pets (consultations by appointment 10:00-18:00 daily, emergency calls any time, house calls); Kampot Veterinary Services (Reggie), 088 285 1000, "available by phone 24 hours a day". Hours for Happy Pets conflict with the other guide page (9-19 vs 10-18).

sources.name: Move to Cambodia - Kampot veterinarians and pets
sources.note: Opened; expat guide (secondary). Koh Pich Veterinarians (183 Street 713 across from Psar Samaki, 012 330 162, daily 7:30-17:00); Kampot Veterinary Services (road to Kep, 088 285 1000, by phone 24 h, facebook.com/Animal.Care.Veterinarian); PPAWS visits Kampot roughly every three months.

sources.name: Move to Cambodia - Vet clinics (listing page 839243)
sources.note: Opened; same Kampot listings as above, confirms them.

sources.name: Expat.com forum - Vet services in Siem Reap
sources.note: Opened; forum posts 12-14 years old (Siem Reap Veterinary Services, Ouk Hok Sy Vet); too dated, nothing used.

sources.name: Kookaburra Vets - Siem Reap Veterinary Care
sources.note: Opened; job-ad page: Siem Reap Veterinary Care, 41 Sala Lodge Rd, Salakamreuk Commune, Siem Reap. No clinic phone or website, so no entry.

sources.name: Cambodianess - Cambodia Tech Sprint Day / pet healthcare
sources.note: Opened; names VSL Clinic, Sunny Animal Hospital, Samaki Clinic, ADI and the RUA Faculty of Veterinary Medicine; no contact details.

sources.name: WVS - WVS Cambodia
sources.note: Opened; community clinic/shelter in Phnom Penh; no address, phone or hours (clinic site ar-cambodia.com not tried - not in search results).

sources.name: EDU-Port Japan - Sunny Animal Hospital
sources.note: Opened; Sunny Animal Hospital (director Tomoki Chimura) and diagnostic centre; no contact data.

sources.name: Australian Embassy - Medical service providers
sources.note: Opened; human healthcare only, no vets.

entries.name: ADI Hospital Phnom Penh (Animal Doctors International)
entries.address: Phnom Penh (street address not published on the website; map link only)
entries.duty: Open every day 9:00-19:00 (public holidays 9:00-12:00). 24/7 emergency and critical care; call the hospital number.
entries.note: Own organisation site (country page and home page) both say 24/7 emergency care. No street address and no separate after-hours number published. The ADI Google Sites page only lists Vietnam/Laos - not relevant.

duty_i18n.it: Aperto tutti i giorni 9:00–19:00 (festivi 9:00–12:00). Pronto soccorso e terapia intensiva 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7; chiamare il numero dell'ospedale.
duty_i18n.pt: Aberto todos os dias, 9h00–19h00 (feriados 9h00–12h00). Urgências e cuidados intensivos 24 h/24, 7 dias por semana; liga para o número do hospital.

entries.name: Animal Mama Veterinary Hospital & Emergency
entries.address: #15, Street 500, Phsar Daeum Thkov (Chamkar Mon), Phnom Penh
entries.duty: Open 9:00-19:00 daily (may close early - call first). Emergency calls after 19:00 on the same number, English only, with an after-hours fee.
entries.note: Phone and hours from the own contact page. Address from easy-cambodia.com and thewellfrog.com (both agree; not on own site). Directories list other phones (010 666 742, 010 500 999) - not used. Directories say "24/7"; own page does not, so false.

duty_i18n.it: Aperto tutti i giorni 9:00–19:00 (può chiudere in anticipo: telefonare prima). Chiamate per urgenze dopo le 19:00 allo stesso numero, solo in inglese, con tariffa fuori orario.
duty_i18n.pt: Aberto todos os dias, 9h00–19h00 (pode fechar mais cedo – liga primeiro). Chamadas de urgência depois das 19h00 no mesmo número, apenas em inglês, com taxa fora de horas.

entries.name: VSL Veterinary Clinic Cambodia
entries.address: #33 Street 334, Sangkat Boeung Keng Kang 1 (BKK1), Phnom Penh
entries.duty: An after-hours phone line is available: +855 88 818 0022.
entries.note: Phones (office 02 398-6640 / 01 746-4681, after hours 088 818-0022) from the IPATA member page; that page has no address and no 24 h statement. Address and 023 986 640 only from thewellfrog.com aggregator. vslveterinary.com not opened (WebFetch refused). Aggregator calls it 24/7 - not accepted.

duty_i18n.it: È disponibile una linea telefonica fuori orario: +855 88 818 0022.
duty_i18n.pt: Linha telefónica fora de horas disponível: +855 88 818 0022.

entries.name: PPAWS (Phnom Penh Animal Welfare Society) clinic
entries.duty: Open Tuesday to Friday and Sunday; call or email ahead. Visiting vets also come to Kampot on set dates.
entries.note: Charity clinic. Only an expat-guide source (undated); ppaws.com could not be opened (not in search results, WebFetch refused). Verify before publishing.

duty_i18n.it: Aperto da martedì a venerdì e la domenica; telefonare o scrivere prima. Veterinari itineranti vengono anche a Kampot in date prestabilite.
duty_i18n.pt: Aberto de terça a sexta-feira e ao domingo; liga ou envia e-mail antes. Veterinários itinerantes também visitam Kampot em datas fixas.

entries.name: Agrovet
entries.address: 33B Street 360 (between Monivong Blvd and Street 63), BKK1, Phnom Penh
entries.note: Expat guide only (undated); agrovet-cambodia.com could not be opened (WebFetch refused). small_animals assumed from the guide listing it as a pet vet - unverified.

entries.name: Siem Reap Veterinary Services
entries.note: Expat guide only (undated); a 2013-era forum thread says the founding vet left and another poster said there was no vet - verify current operation. Facebook page not openable.

duty_i18n.pt: Consultas sob marcação, em dias úteis, 9h00–16h00.

entries.name: Happy Pets Veterinary Clinic
entries.address: Emario Beach Resort, Victory Hill, Sihanoukville
entries.duty: Consultations by appointment, daily. Emergency calls taken at any time; house calls available.
entries.note: Expat guides only. Hours conflict between pages (10-18 vs 9-19), so no hours published. "Emergency calls at any time" is not a 24 h clinic statement.

duty_i18n.it: Visite su appuntamento, tutti i giorni. Chiamate per urgenze accettate a qualsiasi ora; visite a domicilio disponibili.
duty_i18n.pt: Consultas sob marcação, todos os dias. Chamadas de urgência atendidas a qualquer hora; visitas ao domicílio disponíveis.

entries.name: Kampot Veterinary Services (mobile vet, road to Kep)
entries.address: On the road to Kep, Kampot; house calls also in Sihanoukville
entries.duty: Reachable by phone 24 hours a day; house calls.
entries.note: Two expat-guide pages say "available by phone 24 hours a day" - a phone line of a single mobile vet, not a staffed 24 h hospital; Facebook facebook.com/Animal.Care.Veterinarian not openable. Consider downgrading to false if the 24 h flag should mean a staffed clinic.

duty_i18n.it: Raggiungibile per telefono 24 ore su 24; visite a domicilio.
duty_i18n.pt: Contactável por telefone 24 horas por dia; visitas ao domicílio.

entries.name: Koh Pich Veterinarians
entries.address: 183 Street 713, across from Psar Samaki, Kampot
entries.note: Expat guide only; two guide pages agree. kampot.city lists it without details.

notes: KH research 2026-11-12. Thin: no official source reachable (GDAHP/MAFF pages found were laws and WOAH PDFs, no vet or clinic directory; RUA faculty page and hospital not reachable with contact data; no duty rota found; no animal poison line found). Only ADI (own site, 24/7 emergency) and Animal Mama (own contact page) have clinic-own sources; the rest rest on one expat guide (movetocambodia.com). Not reachable / no usable page: ppaws.com, agrovet-cambodia.com, vslveterinary.com (WebFetch refused: not in search results), ar-cambodia.com (WVS), Facebook pages. Left: Sunny Animal Hospital (BKK3, only aggregator phone +855 10 461 212), Japan Animal Hospital (St 63), Samaki Clinic, Animovet Toul Kork (worldpetnet only), PAW Global Veterinary (no contact), Navetco, Siem Reap Veterinary Care (41 Sala Lodge Rd, no phone/site), Battambang (nothing found), Kep, Royal University of Agriculture veterinary hospital (rua.edu.kh).
